tests.coverage: Native/Drizzle, local Turso protocol tests, UTF-8 and SQLite encodings, callback and drain backpressure, Web cancellation, output ownership/cleanup, ZIP decoding and public package entrypoints.

outputEquivalence: All compared workers have identical byte counts and encoded SHA-256 per case, including ZIP.
candidateBuild: The matrix, recheck and final configurations record identical .mjs hashes; verified against final dist.
limitations: No live Turso service or network measurement.
GC profiling perturbs the workload and is separate from uninstrumented performance tests.
The exact phase 2 refactor behind the median shift was not isolated.
RSS is whole-process historical peak; post-GC snapshots measure retained heap separately.
